purpose: Read-only audit of whether continuous log-normal density NLL and centered integer-observation likelihood support the same Time NLL conclusion for the selected matched duration heads.

scope.source: already selected matched proper heteroscedastic log-normal checkpoint and its immutable validation feature cache

datasets.top_code_observation: dt=30 represents duration at least 29.5 days under centered integer bins

observation_likelihood.continuous_replay: original-unit log-normal density for ordinary rows and P(T > 30 | history) for the prior Instacart censor-aware selected metric
observation_likelihood.mode_tie_break: smallest integer among equal maximum counts

checkpoint_role_binding.B: resume_identity.contract_id must equal hard_lmm_frozen_lognormal_duration_v1 and model_role must be absent or B
checkpoint_role_binding.A_rmtpp_thp: resume_identity.contract_id must equal matched_frozen_lognormal_duration_v1 and checkpoint model_role must exactly match the requested role
checkpoint_role_binding.verified_reference_policy: only the 11 completed full-run rows are auditable and every pre-registered reference comparison must pass within its fixed absolute tolerance
checkpoint_role_binding.excluded_row: intermittent_frozen_5000/rmtpp is unavailable because its source checkpoint was missing

continuous_nll_decomposition.scope: uncensored density rows; top-coded rows are reported as survival terms

numerical_contract.log_difference: piecewise log1mexp using log1p or expm1
